_comment: Lab publications without Richard Hann as co-author. They are not on folk.ntnu.no, so scripts/push_uavicinglab.py adds them to the UAV Icing Lab Publications page. Same shape as the folk snapshot: y = year, t = citation text, links = [[linked words, url], ...].
